H1.criterion: Each retry rule has more duplicate trials than each reference rule in Completed view; report each site.

H2.criterion: Scope has more clean confirmations than closure, with no added duplicates, on both sites.

H3.criterion: Each All-view trial shows one new item without a retry.

limitations: Two related public demos; fixed order; three repeats per cell.
Runners share a browser service and host.
Reload survival is not server durability or indefinite closure.
No human review is recorded by this analyzer.

scoring.action_counts: Counts refer to saved action records, not individual browser or tool operations.
scoring.active_state: A task is active when its adjacent visible checkbox is unchecked. Task text in the input is not a task entry.
scoring.admission_budget: Measured from the first scored prepare action for each runner.
scoring.clean_confirmed: Decision says success at or before 60 seconds, and raw post-reload count is one.
scoring.duplicate: At least two exact task labels in the raw post-reload All-view snapshot.
scoring.inference: Counts and descriptive measures only. No p-values or field confidence intervals.
scoring.missing: Missing raw observations remain unknown. They are never changed to zero.
scoring.time: UTC wall time includes model and tool work. It is not website latency.
scoring.verified_clean_confirmed: Clean confirmation plus valid raw records, one visible item at decision, and exactly one active item after reload.
